text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — we’re opening a gentle canary window for the release tomorrow 09:00 UTC. This is a targeted, lower-risk rollout that prioritizes infra-critical services first to reduce the blast radius after last night’s cache invalidation.

mike: timeline? what does "gentle" mean in practice?

elaine: Good q. Plan: 09:00 open canary (2hr), then 09:00–11:00 traffic split to 20% for non-critical services, escalate to 50% later if metrics stable, final ramp to 80% after the 5h check. Infra-critical services get first small batches at 09:00.

sam: are embeddings/model updates in this train?

elaine: Embeddings changes are postponed — we’ll keep model changes minimal. If you have an urgent bugfix that must go, request a freeze-exception.

jordan: I need a freeze-exception for the quant-plugin hotfix — caused 503s in canary last night. I’ll attach the patch and CI results.

elaine: Approved. Tag the PR with "freeze-exception" and add the rollout checklist link. Coordinate with @maya for on-call coverage.

maya: I’ll be on watch during the window. Monitoring checklist: latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, cache miss rate, KV-store ops latency. I’ll post alerts to #eng-oncall.

mike: any special deploy order? we should avoid deploying frontend + cache infra simultaneously.

elaine: Yes — deploy order: infra-critical (load-balancers, cache primitives) -> runtime (serving-runtime) -> control-plane -> frontend. We’ll block concurrent cache infra + frontend.

deploy-bot: [info] Canary window scheduled: 2026-05-10 09:00:00 UTC. Auto-rollbacks enabled for 5xx_rate>0.5% over 5m or latency_p95 increase >25% over baseline.

oncall-bot: [incident summary] Last night’s cache invalidation spike: root cause = stale migration flag in deployment; impact = ~12m elevated 5xx on serving-runtime-canary, mitigated by rollback. Postmortem draft: /linked/doc/runbooks/cache-invalidate-pm.

sam: thanks for the summary. Any manual mitigation steps we need prep for tomorrow?

maya: Prep: ephemeral cache flush playbook, KV rollback script, and circuit-breaker toggle. I’ll pin the commands in #eng-oncall now.

jordan: tagging owners on the quant-plugin patch: @sam @mike. Patch includes a fast-path guard and extra metrics. CI-green.

elaine: Nice. Two action items before 06:00 UTC tomorrow: 1) Push freeze-exception PR and tag it, 2) Owners add safety checks to rollout checklist and confirm in this thread. Mark done when you confirm.

mike: I’ll add the safety checks to the checklist and drop a note when done.

sam: PR pushed and tagged. Added a short rollback test to the CI job.

maya: Watch runbook pinned; KV rollback script uploaded; I’ll run a readiness smoke run at 08:15 UTC.

elaine: Perfect. If anything looks off during the 2hr canary we stop and revert — no heroic manual punches. Keep comms here and in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

mike: copy. I’ll be available during the window.

deploy-bot: [reminder] Canary window begins in 12h. Ensure owners are online.

elaine: Thanks team — this gentle-window + priority shift should help reduce the risk surface while letting low-risk fixes go out. If you need a last-minute exception, ping me directly.
